messages:
sam: Heads-up — sample-app in the monorepo started failing during Vercel edge build after we bumped the SDK to v2.0.0. Works in Node, fails in edge with an imports/exports error.

sam: Error from Vercel: UnhandledPromiseRejectionWarning: Cannot use import statement outside a module (but package.json has "type": "module").

ravi: hmm. Is the SDK using conditional exports and only exposing "import"? Vercel edge tends to be strict about package entry points.

sam: SDK package.json exports look like: 
```json
"exports": {
  ".": "./dist/esm/index.js",
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```

anya: That means consumers doing require() or CJS interop might break. But you said it works in Node? Are you on Node 18 where CJS interop is more forgiving? Edge builds often run in a bundler that rewrites imports and hates ambiguous exports.

sam: Also noticed TS types are not resolved in the workspace consumers after the bump — IDE shows "Cannot find module '@redwood-inference/sdk' or its corresponding type declarations." Our SDK has "types": "dist/types/index.d.ts" but with exports we might need to add a top-level "types" or conditional types export.

ravi: Two quick fixes: 1) add explicit conditional exports for both import and require and also point "types" at a top-level file, 2) add a tiny edge-specific bundle so the edge function imports a single ESM file. Example exports snippet: 
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.js",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
    "default": "./dist/esm/index.js"
  },
  "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts",
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
"types": "dist/types/index.d.ts"
```

anya: For pnpm monorepo weirdness, check if there are multiple copies of the SDK due to peerDeps or hoisting config. If the SDK ends up symlinked differently for the edge builder, it may pick the raw src rather than built dist. Run `pnpm -w -r why @redwood-inference/sdk` and look for duplicates.

sam: Good call. I ran `pnpm why` and saw SDK resolved to workspace:link at root but Vercel build resolves differently. I also tried adding to root .npmrc: 
```
public-hoist-pattern[]=@redwood-inference/*
```
That fixed the workspace resolution for the server build but not for the edge step.

ravi: If bundling is acceptable, add an edge entry point in the sample app that imports from the SDK and then run esbuild during the sample-app build: 
```
esbuild src/edge.ts --bundle --platform=neutral --format=esm --outfile=.vercel/output/functions/edge/entry.mjs
```
This guarantees the edge runtime gets a self-contained ESM artifact.

anya: For types, some consumers (TS) rely on `exports` mapping for `types` via `typesVersions` or conditional types. Add this to SDK package.json if you want TS to find declarations without fiddling with pathMappings: 
```json
"types": "dist/types/index.d.ts",
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts",
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.js",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js"
  }
}
```

sam: After adding the conditional exports + types field and adding a tiny esbuild step for edge, Vercel build no longer fails. One remaining gotcha: our auth singleton kept state across two different copies of the SDK when hoisted twice. So tokens were read from one instance and set on another. Anyone seen that?

ravi: Yeah—common when multiple copies exist. Best is to ensure SDK is deduped (peerDependencies + single hoist) or expose a global symbol (e.g., attach to globalThis.__REDWOOD_SDK__ ) with a guarded init to prevent multiple instances. Prefer dedupe.

anya: Also log for onboarding: add a sample-app README section "Edge builds: bundling vs exports" and mention pnpm public-hoist-pattern, types + exports examples, and the global singleton workaround if you can't dedupe. Small snippet to guard singleton: 
```ts
// ensure single global instance
const globalKey = Symbol.for('redwood.sdk.instance');
if (!(globalThis as any)[globalKey]) {
  (globalThis as any)[globalKey] = createSdk();
}
export default (globalThis as any)[globalKey];
```

ci-bot: Build (sample-app) failed previously 1 of 3 attempts; latest attempt succeeded after PR #452 (exports/types + edge bundle) — duration 1m48s.

sam: Thanks all — will open SDK PR with conditional exports + top-level types and update samples README. Will also add a devx note about pnpm pitfalls.
